_about: Per-crop nutrient content for the survival garden optimiser (scripts/survival-garden.js) and, later, the
game's nutrition model. data/food/crop_nutrition.ron carries energy and three macros only (its trap 3:
"not one micronutrient"); this file carries the rest, per 100 g of the EDIBLE portion, raw, from the
same USDA release. Keyed by data/plants.csv id. A null is a nutrient USDA did not measure for that food
(the optimiser counts it as 0 and says so). Written 2026-11-06 by a node builder over the downloaded
files named under sources; regenerate rather than hand-edit a number.
refuse_pct: the inedible share of the food as purchased (SR28 FOOD_DES Refuse), applied to a harvest
item that is the whole vegetable. edible_share: for harvest items weighed in the shell or hull, the
kernel share data/food/crop_nutrition.ron already uses (refuse is then 0, the shell being the share's).
retention: USDA cooking retention factors (percent of the raw value kept), only the methods the garden
uses; a nutrient a method does not list (manganese, selenium, vitamins D, E, K, pantothenic acid, the
fatty and amino acids, energy) is kept whole, which is the table's own scope, not a measurement.
